gloss: abdication; stepping down from the throne

definitions.gloss: abdication; stepping down from the throne
definitions.explanation: The voluntary relinquishment of a throne or supreme position of authority, especially by a monarch or emperor.

examples.japanese: {天皇|てんのう}が{退位|たいい}された。
{退位|たいい}の{意向|いこう}を{表明|ひょうめい}した。
examples.english: He expressed his intention to abdicate.

examples.japanese: {退位|たいい}に{伴|ともな}い{新|あたら}しい{元号|げんごう}が{制定|せいてい}された。
examples.english: A new era name was established accompanying the abdication.

notes:
Composed of {退|たい} (withdraw, retire) + {位|い} (rank, throne). Gained widespread use in Japan when Emperor Akihito expressed his wish to abdicate in 2016, leading to his abdication on April 30, 2019 — the first by a Japanese emperor in over 200 years. A special law was enacted to make this possible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退位|たいい}する: to abdicate
- {退位|たいい}の{意向|いこう}: intention to abdicate
- {退位|たいい}{式|しき}: abdication ceremony
- {生前|せいぜん}{退位|たいい}: abdication while still alive (as opposed to succession upon death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {即位|そくい}: enthronement, accession to the throne (the opposite of {退位|たいい})
- {辞任|じにん}: resignation (from a political or professional position, not a throne)
- {譲位|じょうい}: ceding the throne (emphasizes transferring the position to a successor)
